lines.t: I looked inside my heart today
And saw how far I’ve walked away
I held my life, I chose my pride
And pushed my brother to the side
Then came the weight, the burning flame
A quiet voice that called my name
You didn't leave me in my fear
Your holy light made all things clear
Conviction brought the truth to light
A revelation in the night
You didn't strike me down in wrath
You led me to the narrow path
I’m shedding off this worldly skin
Crucifying the man within
I put on Christ, renewed and free
Restored in who You made me be
My heart is bowed, my soul made new
In full obedience, following You
Here at Your feet, I give my all
And answer to Your holy call
[Verse 2]
I asked You, Lord, if I had turned
Or if it’s just my soul that burned
You pointed where the sorrow lies
And washed the darkness from my eyes
Now on my knees, the tears run free
I taste the salt, Your grace in me
No longer bound to self and sin
Your holy work has now begun
Conviction brought the truth to light
A revelation in the night
You didn't strike me down in wrath
You led me to the narrow path
I’m shedding off this worldly skin
Crucifying the man within
I put on Christ, renewed and free
Restored in who You made me be
My heart is bowed, my soul made new
In full obedience, following You
Here at Your feet, I give my all
And answer to Your holy call
[Bridge - UK Spoken Rap Section]
Look, I used to mask it all, put my pride up on a pedestal
Living for myself, man, I thought that I was clever, full
Of my own righteousness, chasing what the world demands
Till You broke through the glass and put the mirror in my hands.
Yeah, conviction hit me deep, man, it cut me to the bone
Told me true repentance ain't just tears when I'm alone
It’s the fruit, it’s the shift, it’s the dying to the flesh
Stripping off the old man, waking up refreshed.
Tasting the salt upon my cheek, I know the old is dead
Stepping off the throne, put You as King upon my head!
[Chorus]
I’m shedding off this worldly skin
Crucifying the man within
I put on Christ, renewed and free
Restored in who You made me be
My heart is bowed, my soul made new
In full obedience, following You
Here at Your feet, I give my all
And answer to Your holy call
[Outro]
I taste the salt... I feel Your grace...
The old is gone, without a trace.
Renewed in love, made whole again.
Your Bride is ready, Lord. Amen.
[Fade Out]
[End]
